# balena_image_profile (Data Source)

Reads the one image profile (the `image_profile` resource of the `/resin` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match. Preview: uses the unversioned /resin API root and may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_image_profile" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the image profile. Selects the row when configured.
- `profile_name` (String) API field `profile_name` (short text). Between 2 and 100 characters. Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `release_image_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `release_image` (API field `release_image`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
